mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS taskTotal, count(*) FILTER (WHERE task.status = 'RUNNING') AS runningCount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE task.status = 'SUCCESS') AS successCount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE task.status IN ('FAILED','TIMEOUT')) AS failedCount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE task.status IN ('FAILED','TIMEOUT') AND task.updated_at >= date_trunc('day', now())) AS failedToday, count(*) FILTER (WHERE task.submit_at >= date_trunc('day', now())) AS submittedToday FROM task WHERE task.deleted = false

SELECT task.submit_at::date AS date, count(*) AS submitted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE task.status = 'SUCCESS') AS success, count(*) FILTER (WHERE task.status IN ('FAILED','TIMEOUT')) AS failed FROM task WHERE task.deleted = false AND task.submit_at >= date_trunc('day', now()) - (#{days} - 1) * interval '1 day' GROUP BY task.submit_at::date ORDER BY task.submit_at::date

SELECT c.cluster_id AS clusterId, c.cluster_name AS clusterName, COALESCE(SUM(n.cpu_used), 0) AS cpuUsed, MAX(c.cpu_total) AS cpuTotal, COALESCE(SUM(n.gpu_used), 0) AS gpuUsed, MAX(c.gpu_total) AS gpuTotal, COALESCE(SUM(n.disk_used), 0) AS diskUsed, MAX(c.disk_total) AS diskTotal FROM cluster c LEFT JOIN executor_node n ON n.cluster_id = c.id AND n.deleted = false WHERE c.deleted = false GROUP BY c.id, c.cluster_id, c.cluster_name ORDER BY c.id

SELECT task.task_id AS taskId, task.workflow_name AS workflowName, task.status AS status, task.biz_date AS bizDate, task.fail_reason AS failReason, task.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM task WHERE task.deleted = false AND task.status IN ('FAILED','TIMEOUT') ORDER BY task.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
